prompt:
Our law school team is competing in an ICC international arbitration moot competition next month. We have a messy draft script and some case materials in the workspace. I need you to produce two clean preparation documents based on our case (NovaTech Solutions GmbH v. PacificRim Distributors Ltd., ICC Case 2024/447):

1. A file named `oral_argument_script.md` — a complete, properly structured oral argument script for Oralist 1 (Applicant/Claimant side). The script must cover both issues in dispute: jurisdiction and force majeure. Make it competition-ready, not a rough draft. The old draft at `drafts/old_versions/BROKEN_draft_script_v1.md` has many errors — do NOT simply copy it.

2. A file named `question_list.md` — a question preparation list covering anticipated judge questions for both issues, with at least 5 questions per issue. Each question should be annotated with the relevant paragraph number from the case facts.

The case facts are in `case_materials/facts/moot_problem_facts.md`. Please make both documents ready for actual competition use.
